77274.subject: Ethereum Bets Its Technical Future On Privacy and Quantum Defense
77274.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These were the biggest crypto and DeFi stories today:

* **[Vitalik Buterin](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/vitalik-buterin-s-ethereum-roadmap-prioritizes-quantum-readiness-and-privacy)**[ moves quantum safety up Ethereum's roadmap and drops Verkle trees](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/vitalik-buterin-s-ethereum-roadmap-prioritizes-quantum-readiness-and-privacy)

* **[Trepa and Fireplace](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/two-prediction-markets-shut-down-hours-apart-as-kalshi-and-polymarket-take-93-of-volume)**[ wind down 90 minutes apart as Kalshi and Polymarket take 93% of volume](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/two-prediction-markets-shut-down-hours-apart-as-kalshi-and-polymarket-take-93-of-volume)

* **[BIP-110](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/bip-110-bitcoin-fork-stalls-at-two-blocks-as-its-only-miner-quits)**['s fork chain has not mined a block since Saturday, and its only miner walked](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/bip-110-bitcoin-fork-stalls-at-two-blocks-as-its-only-miner-quits)

* **[Crypto ETPs](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/ether-products-lead-600m-crypto-etp-flow-rebound-in-july)**[ took $600M in July, and ether products got $350M of it](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/ether-products-lead-600m-crypto-etp-flow-rebound-in-july)

Vitalik Buterin laid his 2023 Ethereum roadmap diagram over the Ethereum Foundation's current draft plan on Monday. The most striking part of the comparison, he said, is the set of items missing from the 2023 diagram in any form: privacy, defenses against quantum computers, and an execution engine that reaches past the Ethereum Virtual Machine.

The strawmap is the Foundation's rolling draft for upgrading Ethereum's base layer, revised roughly quarterly, and it now [lays out seven network upgrades by 2029](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/vitalik-buterin-s-ethereum-roadmap-prioritizes-quantum-readiness-and-privacy). Quantum safety got pulled forward. Verkle trees and state expiry, two projects that anchored the 2023 diagram, were replaced outright. Verifiable delay functions and most EVM improvement work went the other way. Buterin named STARKs and AI-accelerated formal verification as the two things “we are okay betting the technical future of Ethereum on.”

The throughput targets sit against a shrinking fee base: Ethereum's base layer collected $8.3 million in July, down 79% from August 2025. And nothing in the five north stars touches issuance. The tapered burn that [consumed Ethereum's week](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/eip-8363-staking-issuance-burn-reaction-kulechov-silagadze) does appear on the diagram, penciled into a 2027-2028 fork and marked with the legend's symbol for uncertainty about ever shipping.

**Read more below!**
